prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1231; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and occipital headache beginning the day after the incident. Examination revealed restricted cervical range of motion, particularly in rotation and extension, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and no focal neurological deficits. Imaging was not indicated based on clinical findings. Treatment over eight visits included manual therapy, gentle cervical range-of-motion exercises, postural education, and a home stretching program. Symptoms improved steadily across the course of care, with pain reduced and range of motion nearing normal by the final visit. Residual mild stiffness with prolonged computer use was noted at discharge. The patient was advised to continue the home exercise program and return if symptoms worsen or new neurological symptoms develop.
